package.name: Upload
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Upload an explicitly selected file after destination approval, to an account's destination or anonymously.

exports.description: Explicit file selection and cloud-upload consent; file bytes and credentials stay in the trusted platform host.

choose.description: Upload the selected file to poo.wang with the saved API key after destination approval.

choose_keyless.description: Upload the selected file to poo.wang anonymously after destination approval and confirmation that no API key is saved.

choose_anonymous.description: Upload the file already selected on Send to Catbox, which needs no account and no key, after approval of that address and of the address its public link lives on.

configure.description: Manage the encrypted API key for this destination without selecting or uploading a file.

status.description: Show whether an API key is saved, whether poo.wang accepts it, and which destinations are available without a key.

actions.label: Upload selected file (poo.wang, API key)
actions.help: Upload after destination approval with files.select and network.http. A refusal stops this attempt.

actions.label: Upload selected file (poo.wang, anonymous)
actions.help: Upload after destination approval with files.select and network.http. A refusal stops this attempt.

actions.label: Upload selected file (Catbox, anonymous)
actions.help: Upload after destination approval with files.select and network.http. A refusal stops this attempt.

actions.label: API key…
actions.help: Manage the saved key with network.http; a missing grant is shown without asking the provider.

settings.label: Upload destination
settings.help: Choose which destination is offered for selected files on Send. poo.wang uses a saved API key or uploads anonymously; Catbox never uses a key.

pages.title: What this extension does
pages.explains: Upload sends the name and contents of one selected file only after you approve the destination. poo.wang receives a saved key only for its API key check and upload or session start. If no key is saved, it uses the service's native anonymous support without a browser cookie or key. Catbox always uploads without an account or key. The extension never receives the file contents or saved key.
pages.changes: Keyless poo.wang allows up to 25 MiB per file and 10 file admissions per UTC day per connecting network address. Links expire after 24 hours. A rejected saved key does not switch to anonymous. If the application cannot determine whether a key is saved, neither poo.wang upload is offered. Catbox allows up to 6 MiB here and returns a public link on https://files.catbox.moe. Cancelling does not undo a completed save or upload.
